text.value: select max(ID) as ReconRunID from tbl_ReconEngine_ReconRun where ReconciliationId = @{variables('iReconciliationID')}

value.value:
@concat('delete Results
from tbl_ReconEngine_Results Results
join tbl_ReconEngine_ReconRun Run
on Run.ID = Results.ReconRunID
where Run.CreateTimestamp < DATEADD(YEAR, -7, GETDATE()) and Run.ReconciliationID =  ', string(variables('iReconciliationID')), '

delete ResearchData
from tbl_ReconEngine_ResearchData ResearchData
join tbl_ReconEngine_ReconRun Run
on Run.ID = ResearchData.ReconRunID
where Run.CreateTimestamp < DATEADD(YEAR, -7, GETDATE()) and Run.ReconciliationID =  ', string(variables('iReconciliationID')), '

delete 
from tbl_ReconEngine_ReconRun
where CreateTimestamp < DATEADD(YEAR, -7, GETDATE()) and ReconciliationID =  ', string(variables('iReconciliationID')))
